AdjacentRatio.description: Irregular when a storey's value is more than ``adjacent`` × an adjacent storey's.
AdjacentRatio.title: AdjacentRatio

CsLimits.description:
Bounds of the seismic response coefficient Cs of the equivalent lateral force method:
Cs ≥ max(``sdsFactor``·SDS·Ie, ``floor``) and, where S1 ≥ ``nearFaultS1``,
Cs ≥ ``nearFaultFactor``·S1 / (R/Ie).
CsLimits.title: CsLimits

DampedTerm.description:
Alpha 9 C20: a damping-dependent term of the spectrum, base + (ref - ζ) / (a + b ζ), at
least ``least`` (ref the rule's ``referenceDamping``; GB 50011 Eqs 5.1.5-1 to -3).
DampedTerm.title: DampedTerm

DampingCorrection.description:
The spectrum's damping correction η(ξ). ``squareRoot``: η = √(numerator / (offset +
100ξ)), at least ``minimum``; ``none``: η = dampingEta; ``table`` (alpha 9 C9b): η of
``points`` (ξ, η), linear between, the end values outside.

points.description: (ξ, η) of the method 'table', ξ ascending.
points.title: Points

DampingCorrection.title: DampingCorrection

DesignEccentricity.description:
The design eccentricity of the static torsion cases: ed = staticAmplification × es +
the accidental share, or es - the accidental share; es from the plan's centres of mass
and rigidity (:mod:`saengine.fem.design_eccentricity`).
DesignEccentricity.title: DesignEccentricity

DesignSpectrumRule.description:
The design spectrum: a method id the pack picks (C4, C1). Empty: ``reducedElastic``.

- ``reducedElastic`` (the default pack's): Sa = pgaFactor·Z·I/R·Cs(T), Cs the elastic shape
  of the site class (S, TB, TC, TD; :func:`saengine.fem.loads.design_acceleration`).
- ``behaviourFactor`` (EN 1998-1 3.2.2.5): ag = Z·I, Sd = ag·S·[2/3 + T/TB·(2.5/q - 2/3)] up
  to TB, ag·S·2.5/q to TC, ·TC/T to TD, ·TC·TD/T² beyond, at least ``lowerBound``·ag from TC
  (:mod:`saengine.fem.spectra`); R stands for q.
- ``mappedSpectral`` (ASCE 7-22 Ch 11-12, :mod:`saengine.fem.spectral_hazard`): the site's
  SDS and SD1 (and S1, TL) entered from the code's hazard tool (Site > Mapped spectral
  values) instead of a zone: a two-period spectrum (T0 = ``t0Share``·TS, TS = SD1/SDS;
  ``rampStart``·SDS at T = 0 up to SDS at T0, SDS to TS, SD1/T to TL, SD1·TL/T² beyond) or
  the site's multi-period design spectrum, × I/R; the equivalent lateral force coefficient
  Cs = SDS/(R/Ie) ≤ SD1/(T R/Ie) (SD1 TL/(T² R/Ie) beyond TL) within ``csLimits``; the
  Seismic Design Category read by the band of SDS and SD1 (``sdsBands``, ``sd1Bands``, the
  more severe; the band after the last where S1 ≥ ``s1Extreme``) as zone packs read it by
  zone; the period's upper limit Cu·Ta from ``periodUpper`` by SD1. The fields after
  ``lowerBound`` are this method's. Alpha 9 C23: with ``siteCoefficients`` SMS, SM1 also
  from SS, S1 by Fa, Fv, and a town may carry SS, S1, TL.
- ``ubc97`` (alpha 9 C16, UBC 1997 Sec 1629-1630 and the codes that adopt it): the same
  two-period spectrum and Cs bounds with 2.5 Ca for SDS and Cv for SD1, Ca and Cv from the
  zone's Z and the soil profile by ``ubc97`` (:class:`Ubc97Rule`).
- ``shapeFactors`` (alpha 9 C18, AS 1170.4 / NZS 1170.5): the site class's spectral shape
  factor Ch(T) (its ``shape`` branches), Cd(T) = (Z I) Ch(T) N Sp / kμ with R standing for μ
  (:class:`ShapeFactorsRule`, :mod:`saengine.fem.spectra`); ``factor`` is not used.
- ``influenceCoefficient`` (alpha 9 C20, GB 50011 5.1.5): Sa = Z I / R α(T)/αmax with Z
  holding αmax, the damping in η1, η2 and γ (:class:`InfluenceCoefficientRule`); ``factor``
  and the damping correction η are not used.

longPeriod.description: reducedElastic: beyond TD the normalized spectrum falls as TC·TD/T² or stays at its value at TD.
longPeriod.title: Longperiod

staticPlateau.description: reducedElastic: the equivalent static method takes the plateau below TB (no rising branch); the dynamic analysis the full shape.
staticPlateau.title: Staticplateau

shapePlateau.description: reducedElastic: the normalized plateau (empty: 2.5); the descending branch plateau × S × (TC / T)^descendingExponent.
shapePlateau.title: Shapeplateau

descendingExponent.description: reducedElastic: the power of TC / T (empty: 1).
descendingExponent.title: Descendingexponent

leastCoefficient.description: reducedElastic: Sa at least factor × Z × I × this (C / R >= this; empty: no least value).
leastCoefficient.title: Leastcoefficient

designShare.description: SDS = share × SMS, SD1 = share × SM1 (mapped values).
designShare.title: Designshare

rampStart.description: Sa at T = 0 as a share of SDS (the ramp to T0).
rampStart.title: Rampstart

sdsBands.description: SDS [g] at which each band from the second starts.
sdsBands.title: Sdsbands

sd1Bands.description: SD1 [g] at which each band from the second starts.
sd1Bands.title: Sd1Bands

s1Extreme.description: S1 [g] from which the band after the last one applies.
s1Extreme.title: S1Extreme

periodUpper.description: (SD1 [g], Cu) points: T ≤ Cu·Ta, Cu linear between, held beyond.
periodUpper.title: Periodupper

DesignSpectrumRule.title: DesignSpectrumRule

DiaphragmConnections.description:
The connection force increase of irregular buildings (the factor is the pack's
``transfer.diaphragm.irregularIncrease``): in the ``categories`` with an irregularity of
``types``. ``wingTypes``: irregularities whose projecting wings need chords and collectors
for independent motion, satisfied by a dynamic 3D analysis when ``wingsDynamicExempt``.
DiaphragmConnections.title: DiaphragmConnections

DiaphragmDeflection.description:
In-plane diaphragm deflection limit [mm]; empty: the code gives no number (the
permissible deflection of the attached elements, which the engineer enters).
DiaphragmDeflection.title: DiaphragmDeflection

DriftAmplificationRow.description:
Alpha 9 C20: the elasto-plastic drift amplification ηp of the structures this row is
for (system groups, at most ``maxStoreys`` storeys), by the storey's yield strength
coefficient ξy: (ξy, ηp) points, linear between, the end values outside.
DriftAmplificationRow.title: DriftAmplificationRow

DriftLimit.description:
A row of the allowable storey drift table; the first row whose conditions hold applies
(a condition left empty always holds), else ``allowableDrift``.

masonry.description: The system is a masonry one.
masonry.title: Masonry

cantileverWalls.description: The walls are cantilevered from the base (no coupling).
cantileverWalls.title: Cantileverwalls

driftTolerantFinishes.description: Interior walls, partitions, ceilings and exterior walls designed to accommodate the storey drift.
driftTolerantFinishes.title: Drifttolerantfinishes

groups.description: The system's group is one of these (empty: any).
groups.title: Groups

DriftLimit.title: DriftLimit

DuctilityOverstrength.description:
Alpha 9 C17: the reduction of the method ``ductilityOverstrength`` (NTC-Sismo CDMX
type, :mod:`saengine.fem.ductility_spectrum`): the design ordinate a / (Q' R) × I, Q the
system's R. Without k: Q' = 1 + (Q - 1) T / Ta below Ta, Q beyond, R = 1; with k:
Q' = 1 + (Q - 1) √(β / k) T / Ta below Ta, 1 + (Q - 1) √(β / k) to Tb,
1 + (Q - 1) √(β p / k) beyond, and R = k1 R0 + k2 with R0 of ``overstrength`` by Q (the
last point at or below Q) and k2 = ``k2Coefficient`` [1 - (T / Ta)^½] >= 0. Q' ×
``regularityFactor`` (at least 1).

overstrength.description: (Q, R0) points of the site-specific form.
overstrength.title: Overstrength

redundancy.description: k1 of R = k1 R0 + k2.
redundancy.title: Redundancy

regularityFactor.description: On Q' (regular 1; the code's factor when irregular).
regularityFactor.title: Regularityfactor

DuctilityOverstrength.title: DuctilityOverstrength

DynamicAnalysis.description:
When the equivalent static method is not enough. ``regularHeights`` and
``irregularHeights``: height [m] above which dynamic analysis is required, by seismic zone
("1".."4"); ``recommendedIrregular``: zones where it is recommended for an irregular building
below that height. The static procedure also needs T below ``periodTcFactor`` × TC and
``periodMax`` and no vertical irregularity (``verticalIrregularity``).
DynamicAnalysis.title: DynamicAnalysis

FoundationCapacityRule.description:
Alpha 9 C5c: capacity design of foundations (method ``overstrengthFactor``): the
foundations' design action EFd = EF,G + γRd Ω EF,E with γRd = ``gammaLow`` for q up to
``qLimit``, ``gammaHigh`` above, Ω the project's or ``omega`` (None: q, the elastic
response), γRd Ω at most q.
FoundationCapacityRule.title: FoundationCapacityRule

HigherModeTable.description:
Alpha 9 C17: the higher mode factor Mv of one group of systems by the spectral ratio
(the pack's ``higherModePeriods``) and the period, bilinear between the points, the end
values outside.

values.description: Mv, a row per ratio, a column per period.
values.title: Values

HigherModeTable.title: HigherModeTable

InfluenceCoefficientRule.description:
Alpha 9 C20: the terms of the method ``influenceCoefficient`` (GB 50011-2010 5.1.4,
5.1.5 type, :mod:`saengine.fem.spectra`): the seismic influence coefficient α(T) as a share
of αmax (Z holds αmax of the frequent earthquake), with the characteristic period Tg the
site class's TC: ``riseStart`` at T = 0 rising to η2 at ``risePeriod``, η2 to Tg, η2 (Tg /
T)^γ to ``tailFrom`` Tg, η2 tailShare^γ - η1 (T - tailFrom Tg) to ``longest`` (held beyond);
γ, η1, η2 by the damping ratio ζ. The rare earthquake (``rare``: αmax by zone, Tg +
``rarePeriodIncrease`` in ``rareIncreaseZones``) for the elasto-plastic drift check.

tailFrom.description: The linear tail from this × Tg.
tailFrom.title: Tailfrom

longest.description: The spectrum's last period [s]; held beyond.
longest.title: Longest

gamma.description: γ, the power of the descending branch.

eta1.description: η1, the slope of the linear tail [1/s].

eta2.description: η2, the damping adjustment of the plateau.

rare.description: αmax of the rare earthquake by seismic zone.
rare.title: Rare

rareIncreaseZones.description: Zones whose rare earthquake takes the Tg increase.
rareIncreaseZones.title: Rareincreasezones

InfluenceCoefficientRule.title: InfluenceCoefficientRule

Irregularities.description: Plan and vertical irregularity thresholds (each block empty: not checked).
Irregularities.title: Irregularities

LateralForceRule.description:
C4: the lateral force method. Base shear × ``correction`` when T ≤ ``periodTcFactor``·TC
and the building has more than ``minStoreys`` - 1 storeys (EN 1998-1 4.3.3.2.2 λ = 0.85);
``distribution``: ``heightPower`` (Fx ∝ wx·hx^k, k 1 to 2 with T) or ``linear`` (Fi ∝ zi·mi,
EN 1998-1 4.3.3.2.3 with the linear mode shape).

minimumShare.description: C7: least base shear V / W by seismic zone (IS 1893 Table 7); empty: none.
minimumShare.title: Minimumshare

topForce.description: Ft = factor T V <= maxShare V at the top when T > periodFrom; the rest distributed (empty: none).

LateralForceRule.title: LateralForceRule

ModalCombinationRule.description:
Alpha 9 C5c: the combination of the modal maxima (method ``independence``): SRSS where
every pair of modes is independent (Tj <= ``ratio`` Ti), else CQC.
ModalCombinationRule.title: ModalCombinationRule

MultiPeriodRule.description:
SMS and SM1 from a multi-period MCER spectrum (Sa [g] by T [s]): SMS = ``smsShare`` ×
the largest Sa from ``smsPeriods[0]`` to ``smsPeriods[1]``, at least Sa at the first;
SM1 = the largest T·Sa from ``sm1Periods[0]`` to ``sm1Periods[1]`` (``sm1PeriodsSoft`` for
the ``softClasses``); SDS, SD1 = ``designShare`` × them. Used when the project gives the
MCER spectrum and not SDS and SD1.
MultiPeriodRule.title: MultiPeriodRule

planDimension.description: C7: T = Ct·h^m / √d, d the base plan dimension along the shaking [m] (False: T = Ct·h^m).
planDimension.title: Plandimension

wallArea.description: T = Ct·h^m / √Aw, Aw = Σ Awi (wallBase + min(Lwi/h, wallRatioMax)²) of the first storey's walls along the shaking [m²]; at least the lowerFamily's T.
wallArea.title: Wallarea

lowerFamily.description: The family whose period bounds this one from below.
lowerFamily.title: Lowerfamily

RareDriftLimit.description: Alpha 9 C20: the elasto-plastic storey drift limit [θp] of the systems of ``groups``.
RareDriftLimit.title: RareDriftLimit

RareDriftRule.description:
Alpha 9 C20: the elasto-plastic storey drift under the rare earthquake by the simplified
method (GB 50011-2010 5.5.2-5.5.5 type, :mod:`saengine.fem.two_level_seismic`): Δup = ηp
Δue, Δue the elastic storey drift under the rare earthquake (the frequent earthquake's
drift × α_rare(T1) / α(T1) of the influenceCoefficient spectrum), ηp by the storey count
and the yield strength coefficient ξy (``yieldStrengthRatio``, a project's Code Value: the
storey's yield shear over its elastic rare-earthquake shear), at most [θp] h. Checked in the
zones of ``zones``; empty: every zone of the rare earthquake.
RareDriftRule.title: RareDriftRule

RegularityCriteria.description:
Alpha 9 C5c: regularity in plan and in elevation by criteria (method ``criteria``,
:mod:`saengine.fem.seismic_regularity`; EN 1998-1 4.2.3 type) and what follows from them.

Plan: each floor's slenderness Lmax / Lmin at most ``slendernessMax``; its outline within a
convex envelope whose area exceeds the floor's by at most ``compactnessShare``; at each
storey the eccentricity e0 of the centre of stiffness (from the moments of inertia of the
columns' and walls' sections) from the centre of mass (the floor's centroid) at most
``eccentricityShare`` × the torsional radius r, and r at least the radius of gyration ls of
the floor (``torsionalRadius``). Elevation: the lateral systems run from the base to the
top (the offsets of the irregularity checks), setbacks preserving symmetry each at most
``setbackShare`` of the dimension below, a single one in the lower ``baseHeightShare`` of
the height at most ``baseSetbackShare``, unsymmetric ones each at most
``unsymmetricShare`` and in all at most ``unsymmetricTotal`` of the base dimension.

Consequences: a structure not regular in elevation takes q × ``elevationFactor``; one not
regular in plan takes αu/α1 as the mean of 1 and the system's (``planAverage``); the
lateral force method needs regularity in elevation (``dynamicAnalysis``); a planar model
needs regularity in plan (SAEngine always analyses the spatial model).

symmetryTolerance.description: A setback is symmetric when its two sides differ by at most this share of it (SAEngine practice).
symmetryTolerance.title: Symmetrytolerance

RegularityCriteria.title: RegularityCriteria

SeismicGrade.description:
Alpha 9 C20: one seismic (detailing) grade: its name, the detailing level it stands for
in SAEngine's levels, and the design factors the code gives it (by key: strongColumn ηc,
columnShear ηvc, beamShear ηvb, axialRatio μN, confinement λv ...).
SeismicGrade.title: SeismicGrade

SeismicGradeRow.description:
Alpha 9 C20: the grade of the systems of ``groups`` up to ``maxHeight`` [m] (empty: any
height), by the intensity column.
SeismicGradeRow.title: SeismicGradeRow

SeismicGradesRule.description:
Alpha 9 C20: seismic grades by structure type, intensity and height (GB 50011-2010 Table
6.1.2 type, :mod:`saengine.fem.two_level_seismic`): the zone's intensity column
(``columns``), raised ``raise`` columns of ``order`` for the occupancy categories that take
the measures of a higher intensity, the first row of the system's group whose height holds,
the grade's level and factors (reported with the seismic design).

raise.description: Occupancy category -> columns the measures are raised by.
raise.title: Raise

SeismicGradesRule.title: SeismicGradesRule

Separation.description:
Separation from adjacent structures: the gap to the property line is at least
``propertyLineFactor``·δ; between units of one property the ``sameProperty`` combination
("srss" or "sum") of the two δ; times ``equalFloorLevelsFactor`` where the floors align.
Separation.title: Separation

ShapeBranch.description:
Alpha 9 C18: one branch of a site class's spectral shape factor Ch(T) (AS 1170.4 Table
6.4, NZS 1170.5 Table 3.1 type): Ch = a + b T + c (t0 / T)^n, at most ``most``, for T up
to ``upTo`` [s] (empty: the last branch, beyond).
ShapeBranch.title: ShapeBranch

ShapeFactorsRule.description:
Alpha 9 C18: the terms of the method ``shapeFactors`` (AS 1170.4 Section 6, NZS 1170.5
Section 5 type, :mod:`saengine.fem.spectra`): Cd(T) = (Z I) Ch(T) N(T, D) Sp / kμ, the
system's R standing for the structural ductility factor μ.

performance.description: (μ, Sp) points: Sp linear between, the end values beyond.
performance.title: Performance

ductilityPeriod.description: kμ = μ from this period [s] on, (μ - 1) T / this + 1 below; empty: kμ = μ.
ductilityPeriod.title: Ductilityperiod

softDuctility.description: Soft: kμ = μ below this μ, else (μ - this) T/softPeriod + this.
softDuctility.title: Softductility

leastZShare.description: Cd at least (this Z + leastOffset) I.
leastZShare.title: Leastzshare

faultDistance.description: D [km] of the site to the nearest major fault (a project's value); empty: N = 1.
faultDistance.title: Faultdistance

nearFault.description: (T [s], Nmax) points of the near-fault factor.
nearFault.title: Nearfault

ShapeFactorsRule.title: ShapeFactorsRule

ShearCoefficientRule.description:
Alpha 9 C19: the standard shear coefficient method (BSL Enforcement Order Art. 88, MLIT
Notification 1793 type): the storey shear Qi = Ci ΣWi, Ci = Z Rt Ai C0 (the design spectrum
method ``standardShearCoefficient``, :mod:`saengine.fem.shear_coefficient`).

Rt (the vibration characteristic factor) of the period T and the site class's corner TC:
1 while T < TC, 1 - ``transition`` (T/TC - 1)² up to ``transitionEnd`` TC, ``longFactor``
TC / T beyond. Ai (the distribution of the storey shear coefficient over the height) of
αi = the weight above storey i over the total: 1 + (1/√αi - αi) ``aiNumerator`` T / (1 +
``aiDenominator`` T), when the lateral force distribution is ``shearCoefficientAi``. C0 the
standard shear coefficient of the primary design (``standardCoefficient``) and of the
required horizontal capacity (``ultimateCoefficient``).

ultimateCoefficient.description: C0 of the required horizontal capacity.
ultimateCoefficient.title: Ultimatecoefficient

transitionEnd.description: × TC: the end of the parabolic transition.
transitionEnd.title: Transitionend

ShearCoefficientRule.title: ShearCoefficientRule

shape.description: Branches of the spectral shape factor Ch(T), in period order; empty: the shape of S, TB, TC, TD.
shape.title: Shape

vs30.description: (lower, upper) average shear wave speed of the top 30 m [m/s] of the class, where the code defines the class by it; empty: by the description.
vs30.title: Vs30

SiteCoefficientTable.description:
Alpha 9 C23: one site coefficient table (Fa by SS, Fv by S1): the factor of each site
class at the mapped values ``points`` [g], linear between, the end values outside.

classes.description: Site class id -> the factor at each point.
classes.title: Classes

SiteCoefficientTable.title: SiteCoefficientTable

SiteCoefficients.description:
Alpha 9 C23: SMS = Fa·SS and SM1 = Fv·S1 from the site's (or its town's) mapped values,
used where neither SDS, SD1 nor SMS, SM1 are given (the IBC / ASCE 7-05 to 7-16 form).
SiteCoefficients.title: SiteCoefficients

SiteSpecificStudy.description: Site classes the code gives no spectrum for: they need a site-specific study.
SiteSpecificStudy.title: SiteSpecificStudy

SiteSpectrum.description:
Alpha 9 C17: the elastic spectrum of one site class (zone) of the method
``ductilityOverstrength``: a = a0 + (c - a0) T / Ta below Ta, c to Tb, beyond it
c (Tb / T)^r; with ``k`` (the site-specific form) c p (Tb / T)² with
p = k + (1 - k)(Tb / T)². In g and s.
SiteSpectrum.title: SiteSpectrum

SoftStoreyDesign.description:
Design of a soft storey without the overstrength factor. ``forceFactors``: the soft
storey's columns and beams take ``frameFactor`` × the earthquake forces, its structural walls
``wallFactor`` ×; ``types``: the irregularity types that make a storey soft.
SoftStoreyDesign.title: SoftStoreyDesign

SpectralMatching.description:
P5: spectral matching of a record to the target (``fem.spectral_matching``), by method
id: ``frequencyDomain`` (the Fourier amplitudes adjusted by the ratio of the target to the
record's spectrum, iterated, with a baseline correction). The record is matched from ``lowerShare`` × the lower to ``upperShare`` × the upper bound
of the procedure's period range on ``points`` periods, until every ordinate there is within
``tolerance`` of the target or after ``iterations``; ``baselineOrder``: the degree of the
polynomial taken off the displacement.
SpectralMatching.title: SpectralMatching

SpectrumOrdinates.description:
Alpha 9 C17: the design spectrum and the equivalent static base shear from the site's
(or its town's) uniform hazard spectrum, an option of ``mappedSpectral`` (NBCC 2020
4.1.8.4 and 4.1.8.11 type, :mod:`saengine.fem.spectral_hazard`): S(T) the spectrum's
ordinates, linear between them, held beyond the last; at and below the first of
``shortPeriods`` the largest ordinate of those periods. SDS and SD1 of the bands stand for
S at ``bandPeriods``. V/W = S(T) Mv I / R, at least S(least period of the system's group)
Mv I / R and, for systems with Rd at least ``capFromRd``, at most the largest
share × S(period) of ``capShares`` × I / R; Mv from ``higherMode`` by the system's group,
the ratio S(``higherModePeriods[0]``) / S(``higherModePeriods[1]``) and T (1 without a
table of the group).

referenceClass.description: Site class of the towns' spectra (empty: any class).
referenceClass.title: Referenceclass

minimumPeriod.description: Least period [s] of the base shear by higher mode group ('default' for the rest); empty: no least value.
minimumPeriod.title: Minimumperiod

capFromRd.description: The cap applies to systems with Rd at least this.
capFromRd.title: Capfromrd

SpectrumOrdinates.title: SpectrumOrdinates

SpectrumTypeGuidance.description:
Alpha 9 C5c: when to choose the pack's second spectrum type: ``type`` where the
earthquakes that contribute most to the hazard have a surface-wave magnitude Ms at most
``magnitude``.
SpectrumTypeGuidance.title: SpectrumTypeGuidance

StabilityRule.description:
θ, a method id (C4, C1). ``elasticOverImportance`` (the default pack's): θ = Px δe/(I Vx
h), θmax = 0.5/Cd ≤ ``thetaCap``; ``elasticDrift`` (ASCE 7-22 Eq 12.8-16, θ = Px Δ Ie/(Vx
hsx Cd) with Δ = Cd δe/Ie): θ = Px δe/(Vx h), θmax = 0.5/Cd ≤ ``thetaCap``; ``designDrift``
(EN 1998-1 4.4.2.2): θ = Ptot dr/(Vtot h) with dr = Cd·de (Cd standing for qd), θmax =
``thetaCap``. Below ``ignoreBelow`` second order effects need not be taken into account; up
to ``amplifyUpTo`` they may be by 1/(1 - θ).
StabilityRule.title: StabilityRule

StoreyRatio.description:
A storey irregular when its value is below ``storeyAbove`` × the storey above's, or
below ``threeAbove`` × the mean of the three storeys above (empty: not checked).
StoreyRatio.title: StoreyRatio

StoreyStrength.description:
How a storey's lateral strength is estimated for the weak storey check. ``shearStrength``:
the sum of the nominal shear strengths of the storey's columns and structural walls in the
direction, Vn = concreteFactor·λ·√f'c·bw·d + Av·fyt·d/s, d = depthFactor × the depth.
StoreyStrength.title: StoreyStrength

row.description: Row of the code's system table.
row.title: Row

masonry.description: A masonry system: its walls are designed as masonry.
masonry.title: Masonry

group.description: Group of the code's system table (bearingWall, dualSpecial...).
group.title: Group

higherModeGroup.description: Group of the higher mode factor table (Mv) and least period.
higherModeGroup.title: Highermodegroup

dual.description: A dual system (one row of the table).
dual.title: Dual

SystemCombination.description: How the values of several systems in one direction combine: "min" or "max".
SystemCombination.title: SystemCombination

TimeHistoryRules.description:
Ground motion suites of the response history procedures (B19; B36 for the nonlinear
target). ``method``: how a suite is scaled (``periodRange``: the mean spectrum of the
records, or of the pairs' SRSS spectra, is not below ``singleRatio`` / ``pairRatio`` times
the target spectrum at every period from ``periodLower``·T to ``periodUpper``·T, the
spectra ``spectrumDamping`` damped); ``minimumRecords`` per suite; ``meanFrom``: from this
many records (or pairs) the design value is the mean of their peaks, fewer the largest;
``baseShearShare``: the responses are scaled by share·V/Vth where the suite's base shear
Vth is below share·V (the equivalent static V); ``scaleDrifts``: that factor also on the
displacements and drifts; ``simultaneousPairs``: a pair's components act together (no
orthogonal 100 % + 30 % rule); ``targets``: by procedure (``linear``, ``nonlinear``).

pairCombination.description: The spectrum of a pair: the SRSS of its two components, the maximum-direction (RotD100) spectrum, or each component's own (the mean of each component must meet the criterion).
pairCombination.title: Paircombination

periodBasis.description: The period range of a pair: periodLower to periodUpper times the longer fundamental period (governing), or periodLower times the shorter to periodUpper times the longer (bounds).
periodBasis.title: Periodbasis

matchedRatio.description: The criterion of a suite of spectrally matched records (empty: the single or pair ratio).
matchedRatio.title: Matchedratio

TimeHistoryRules.title: TimeHistoryRules

TimeHistoryTarget.description:
The spectrum records are scaled to: the design spectrum with ``R`` and ``I`` (empty: the
building's own). P5: ``factor`` times it (e.g. the maximum considered earthquake as a
multiple of the design spectrum); the other fields, when given, replace the table's own
for this procedure (empty: the table's).

spectrum.description: The design spectrum with R and I, or (packs whose design spectrum is by a behaviour factor) the elastic response spectrum of the same shape with I.
spectrum.title: Spectrum

modification.description: How the records of this procedure are modified to the target by default: amplitude scaling over the period range, or spectral matching (the table's ``matching``).
modification.title: Modification

TimeHistoryTarget.title: TimeHistoryTarget

TopForce.description: Alpha 9 C10: the concentrated top force Ft of the equivalent static method.

TorsionalEffectsRule.description:
Alpha 9 C5c: accidental torsional effects by the factor δ = 1 + ``coefficient`` x / Le
on each element's earthquake effects (method ``deltaFactor``, EN 1998-1 4.3.3.2.4 type),
where the analysis has no accidental eccentricity cases: x the element's distance from the
centre of mass across the earthquake, Le the plan's extent across it; the larger of the two
directions' δ, rounded up to ``step``.
TorsionalEffectsRule.title: TorsionalEffectsRule

Ubc97Rule.description:
Alpha 9 C16: the seismic coefficients Ca and Cv of the UBC-97 form (UBC 1997 Tables
16-Q, 16-R; adopted by NSCP 2015 Sec 208 and BCP SP-2007) by soil profile and Z, given at
the zone factors ``zValues`` (linear between them for an entered Z, held beyond). From
``nearSourceFrom`` (Z) up, Ca × Na and Cv × Nv, the near-source factors by the seismic
source type and the distance to the source [km] (``na`` / ``nv``: (distance, factor)
points, linear between, held beyond; the project may enter Na and Nv instead; without
either they are 1.0 and the settings check says so). The spectrum is the two-period one
of ``mappedSpectral`` with the plateau 2.5 Ca and Cv/T (T0 = 0.2 TS, TS = Cv / 2.5 Ca, Ca
at T = 0), so V = Cv I W / (R T) ≤ 2.5 Ca I W / R (``csLimits.sdsFactor`` 0.044 gives the
least 0.11 Ca I W); from ``nearSourceFrom`` V ≥ ``nearSourceFactor`` Z Nv I W / R. The zone
of the town (or the zone nearest the entered Z) reads the category table.

VerticalComponentRule.description:
Alpha 9 C5c: the vertical seismic action (method ``verticalSpectrum``): only where avg =
``ratio`` [spectrum type] × ag exceeds ``threshold`` g; Ev / D = share × avg × ``plateau`` /
``behaviour`` (the vertical design spectrum's plateau, q = 1.5), with the orthogonal share
of the combination; the members of ``members`` (applied to every member, on the safe side).
